Delivery tab (WorkItemsTab.tsx:32) replaces the grid with Loading text, so no box there, which is consistent. findings.remediation: Design: decide per tab which loading look holds and make P9 and feature-delta.md agree. If the no-box-while-loading negative stands for a tab, oracle adds one loading-state observation for that tab. If not, design removes the clause. Completion stays blocked until resolved.
